quest.title: The Missing Miner
quest.description: Uncle He, a veteran miner at The Chasm, went missing when the mine was previously evacuated. But due to a series of coincidences, you unearth evidence that he may still be alive...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x250, Primogem x30, Mora x30000, Hero's Wit x3

dialogues.speaker: Work Handbook
dialogues.text: (A miner's log, with the name "He" on its cover — probably the name of the owner.)

dialogues.speaker: Work Handbook
dialogues.text: (On the first few pages, it reads:)

dialogues.speaker: Work Handbook
dialogues.text: "Qi Ding's been looking for his daughter's toy, but it's nowhere to be found. Lemme go deeper into the mine and see if I can find it for him..."

dialogues.speaker: Work Handbook
dialogues.text: "...There's an itching in my ears..."

dialogues.speaker: Work Handbook
dialogues.text: "...It's so itchy, like bugs in my ears... Ugh, it just won't give me a rest. I'm gonna run out of food soon. According to that voice, I... Huh. But is this mushroom really edible?"

dialogues.speaker: Work Handbook
dialogues.text: On the following pages, it reads: "I can hear it. Hee-hee, mushroom meat... hee-hee... mushroom meat. So delicious... Hahaha, mushroom meat..."

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You suddenly hear whispering coming from behind you:\n"Hee-hee... mushroom meat... Hee-hee..."
You... Hee-hee, what are you doing here?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa! This guy looks terrible!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #And he just popped up without making a single noise, {NICKNAME}...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Could he be...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Probably not.
Hee-hee, wh—why are you here?
Have you run out of food as well?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Are you Uncle He?
Huh... Huh? Youngster, what are you saying? I can't hear you.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: I'm asking if you are Uncle He!

dialogues.speaker: Uncle He
dialogues.text: Oooh, yes. Hee-hee, that's me-hee-hee.

dialogues.speaker: Uncle He
dialogues.text: Are you also trapped here like me? Did you run out of food too? *sigh* ... How unlucky.

dialogues.speaker: Uncle He
dialogues.text: Hee-hee, but no worries. I've got some food here... You must be famished... Hee-hee...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Now that topic's making Paimon's tummy grumble.

choices.text: This "mushroom meat" stuff looks very suspicious!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Uh... You're right. He seems a bit cooked in the head, and what's with that strange complexion? Paimon bets it has to do with the mushroom meat!

response.speaker: Uncle He
response.text: Mushroom meat? Hee-hee, yes, it's delicious!

response.speaker: Uncle He
response.text: Here, would you like some?

response.speaker: Uncle He
response.text: Hahaha, how do you like it? Mm... What—

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: What's the matter?

response.speaker: Uncle He
response.text: The mushroom meat is gone!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: ...Y'know what? Forget it, let's go back to the camp now!

response.speaker: Uncle He
response.text: I'm not going! I've run out of mushroom meat!

response.speaker: Uncle He
response.text: Without it, I won't even have the strength to walk. I'm not going anywhere... No mushroom meat... and no food anywhere else.

response.speaker: Uncle He
response.text: But with mushroom meat, I can go anywhere!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Then, where can we find you some?

response.speaker: Uncle He
response.text: Mushroom meat... Oh, hee-hee, I know where it is. Lemme find some for us. Let's fill our tummies and then we'll have the strength to work!

response.speaker: Uncle He
response.text: It should be around here...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Well, {NICKNAME}, Paimon guesses we can only do as he says.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: This does seem to be the only option now.

response.speaker: Uncle He
response.text: Mushroom meat... Hee-hee... big mushroom meat...

choices.text: Don't just chow on whatever suspicious stuff you find!

talks.objective: Collect "mushroom meat" together with Uncle He

dialogues.speaker: Uncle He
dialogues.text: Mushroom meat... Hee-hee... A mushroom meal in my tummy, small mushrooms, mushroom creatures, big mushrooms... Hee-hee...

dialogues.speaker: Jinwu
dialogues.text: Uncle He? What's happened to your face?

dialogues.speaker: Jinwu
dialogues.text: *sigh*... I knew you were alive! To think that your family even invited me to your funeral! I refused to go, you know. Told them that nothing was certain yet without a body.

dialogues.speaker: Jinwu
dialogues.text: Look at your face. It must've been tough for you, being trapped in the mine like that. But anyway, I'm glad that you're still alive!

dialogues.speaker: Uncle He
dialogues.text: Being alive is good, yes! Living, breathing mushrooms are delicious! Hee-hee...

dialogues.speaker: Jinwu
dialogues.text: Uncle He?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: He was like this when we found him.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: He wasn't quite all there... and he kept saying that he wanted to eat mushrooms.

dialogues.speaker: Jinwu
dialogues.text: Mushrooms...

dialogues.speaker: Jinwu
dialogues.text: The Chasm is a dangerous place for ordinary people. Plants and fungi growing here could also be harmful to the human body. That's why Huishan Hall has set strict rules against eating these things.

dialogues.speaker: Jinwu
dialogues.text: But Uncle He's been trapped down here all these years with nothing else to eat.

dialogues.speaker: Jinwu
dialogues.text: How am I supposed to face his family with him in this state?

response.speaker: Jinwu
response.text: Now that you mention it, Khedive might be able to help. After all, he's a scholar from Sumeru. He must've conducted some research on mushrooms.

response.speaker: Jinwu
response.text: Please wait here. I'll bring him over to check up on Uncle He.

response.speaker: Uncle He
response.text: Mushroom meat... mushroom meat...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: *sigh* With how messed up Uncle He is, Paimon's really not sure if he can recover.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: If he goes back to his family like this, they'll still be pretty saddened...

response.speaker: Khedive
response.text: You can't just kidnap me here while I was halfway through my report, Jinwu! I know you're in charge of the team's safety, but you can't just disturb my research like that...

response.speaker: Khedive
response.text: I'm seriously considering cutting your budget as they proposed.

response.speaker: Jinwu
response.text: Never mind the budget.

response.speaker: Jinwu
response.text: Please check on this man here...

response.speaker: Uncle He
response.text: It's so itchy inside my earsies... Hee-hee...

response.speaker: Khedive
response.text: Huh? Who is he? And why does he look like that?

response.speaker: Khedive
response.text: #Did you find him, {NICKNAME}? ...Seriously, how are you always able to stumble upon such peculiar events...

response.speaker: Khedive
response.text: Then... How was he like when you found him?

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: You tell Khedive what happened to Uncle He...\nKhedive performs a careful examination on him.

response.speaker: Khedive
response.text: He's fine. It's not a big deal.

response.speaker: Khedive
response.text: You know how he always complains about the itchiness in his ears? That's because the spores of the fungi have entered his ears.

response.speaker: Khedive
response.text: Although long-term consumption of this type of fungus — I mean, mushroom — does impair one's sanity, it doesn't hurt the body.

response.speaker: Jinwu
response.text: So you're saying he can recover?

response.speaker: Khedive
response.text: I've already cleared his body of the fungi and made some medicine to treat his neurological disorder.

response.speaker: Khedive
response.text: He's very likely to recover if given ample rest.

response.speaker: Jinwu
response.text: I see. Then, about the cost of the medicine...

response.speaker: Khedive
response.text: None of the ingredients are expensive — they're only worth a month's meals at Xinyue Kiosk. It's not a big deal.

response.speaker: Jinwu
response.text: Uh... I—I'll figure out some way to repay you...

response.speaker: Khedive
response.text: No need to repay me — as a matter of fact, this incident gives me something new to write in my report.

response.speaker: Khedive
response.text: Ever since I came across these peculiar mushrooms in The Chasm, I've been curious about the long-term consequences of eating them, but I haven't found a willing assistant yet.

response.speaker: Khedive
response.text: I mean, someone whose responsibility is to eat the mushrooms. Everyone seems to have reservations. Although they know that no great harm will come to them, they just don't dare to eat the things.

response.speaker: Khedive
response.text: But... given how peculiar The Chasm is, the environment here could be another reason for his symptoms. Anyway, just have him take the medicine and get some rest. He's very likely to recover, even now.

response.speaker: Jinwu
response.text: What a relief... I'll bring him up to the surface later.

response.speaker: Jinwu
response.text: Once he's recovered, I'll bring him home and inform his friends as well.

response.speaker: Jinwu
response.text: He's a veteran miner, and an agile one, too. He took very good care of youngsters who were new in the mine.

response.speaker: Jinwu
response.text: When he went missing a few years back, everyone wondered why Rex Lapis didn't protect him. A good man's life shouldn't have ended that way, they said.

response.speaker: Jinwu
response.text: I'm sure his friends will be much comforted by the news that he's back.

choices.text: "Test subject" is more the word, don't you think?

response.speaker: Khedive
response.text: You can say that, but we've studied these mushrooms and come to the conclusion that they won't cause any irreversible damage to either the body or the mind.

choices.text: Do you know anyone who does research on mushrooms?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: About Khedive...

response.speaker: Jinwu
response.text: He's still in the camp above. He said he wanted to organize his research materials and bring them down here...

response.speaker: Jinwu
response.text: We'll just have to wait till then to ask him about the situation.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon hopes that Uncle He will recover.

response.speaker: Jinwu
response.text: He's a veteran miner, and an agile one, too. He took very good care of youngsters who were new in the mine.

response.speaker: Jinwu
response.text: When he went missing a few years back, everyone wondered why Rex Lapis didn't protect him. A good man's life shouldn't have ended that way, they said.

response.speaker: Jinwu
response.text: I'm sure everyone'll be elated to see him recover and return.

response.speaker: Jinwu
response.text: #{NICKNAME}, you have my thanks. Once Khedive is done checking on Uncle He, I'll get him out of The Chasm — I will, whatever happens.

response.speaker: Jinwu
response.text: Thank you so much. I really don't know how I can repay you.

choices.text: Do you know anyone who does research on mushrooms?

talks.objective: Black Screen Conversation with Uncle He

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: He took them all out in a whoosh!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa! So strong!

dialogues.speaker: Uncle He
dialogues.text: Hee-hee... Mushroom meat, mushroom meat...

dialogues.speaker: Uncle He
dialogues.text: Ever since I started eating mushroom meat, my lower back pain left me and I got more strength. Hee-hee, it's like I've grown a few years younger!

dialogues.speaker: Uncle He
dialogues.text: And mushroom creatures are more delicious than mushroom meat! The bigger, the tastier... Hee-hee...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Could it be that Uncle He got so strong from eating mushroom meat?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}, since it might grant us more power, why don't we give it a whirl?

choices.text: You sure it's "more power" that you're after, huh?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon just wants to see how it tastes!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But back on topic, Uncle He should be fine with following us back now, right?

response.speaker: Uncle He
response.text: Mushroom meat... Hee-hee, yummy!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Uncle He, let's go back to the camp together!

response.speaker: Uncle He
response.text: Huh? "Together"? Sure, let's have the mushroom meat together. Hee-hee, air-dried mushroom meat can be stored for a long, long time...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon means we're going back to the camp together!

response.speaker: Uncle He
response.text: The "damp"? What got damp? Oh, what does it matter? I'm fine with it... Hee-hee, now that I've eaten mushroom meat, damp or dry, I can go anywhere!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: *sigh*

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #{NICKNAME}, let's bring Uncle He back to see Jinwu.

choices.text: Please be less creative with your diet!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh, alright, Paimon gets it...
